_note: THE MILITARY FAMILY, 7 OF ~10: THE BEACONS.
Three beacons are guiding the occupiers' supply runs in. Shut them down in any order; whoever was expecting a
delivery comes to see why. The verb is SILENCE.
Written to the delve marker set (outside entrance, centre, item markers, boss, wounded) on his ruling, so the
lint pool is EMPTY on military sites until the markers are on them (missionboard06a's note says why).
Every word holds at any military site: nothing names the site, the faction or the weather; everything the lines
point at is placed. Pay: med, capped.

place._theme: Military sites; the family's marker set.

prose.name: Sabotage: Beacon Network on <Planet>
prose.briefing: Three beacons at the <Place> are guiding the occupiers' supply runs in. Without them, the runs miss.
prose.card: Sabotage contract. The <Place> on <Planet> runs a beacon network supplying the occupiers. Shut down all three beacons. Payment on contract completion.

beats.objective: Shut down the beacons at the <Place>
beats.journal: One beacon off. It was playing a little three note chime between bursts. I don't know why that made it worse.
beats.name: Supply Beacon

beats.journal: One beacon off. Someone had taped a picture of a ship to it, the way you'd tape one to a fridge.
beats.name: Guide Beacon

beats.journal: One beacon off, and its backup battery pulled so it stays off.
beats.name: Relay Beacon

beats.objective: Deal with the people coming to check
beats.journal: With all three beacons dark, the next supply run went somewhere else. The ones waiting for it came to find out why, and found me.
say: Their run just went straight past. Without the beacons, nobody out there knows where to land.

broadcast: There are three beacons in there guiding their runs in. Turn them all off. Somebody's waiting on that delivery, and they'll come and ask.
_speech: On a board the broadcast waits for him at the site. Not yet heard in game; his ear decides. No names, places, factions or currency in a voiced line.
